issues: Showing Shule as an infant is a reasonable inference from Kib begetting him, but the verse does not specify when or how Shule is visually present during Kib’s captivity.
Moron is where Shule was carried captive (verse 17), but verse 18 does not explicitly locate Noah’s house or the prison there.

The rescue is anchored to Noah’s house and the prison, but their spatial relationship is unspecified; avoid implying the prison is inside the house or presenting the separate actions as a single simultaneous moment.
Noah is explicitly slain, but how he is slain is unspecified; show no particular method or visual detail beyond the non-gory action.
Narration is an exact excerpt from Ether 7:18. The separate narration excerpt is acceptable; do not add words or ellipses.
